'UNSAN SUPERVISING ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER Economic Enterprise Development and Management Office CITY OF ILIGAN Dear Madam: DILG Legal 2912 2012 or R FLEA D SIENATURE: DArr. TIME: GONrRQL / This refers to your letter seeking advice on whether or not the personnel of the City of Iligan would also benefit from the exemption granted to the DEVELOPMENT ACADEMY OF THE PHILIPPINES (DAP) from the PI,200.OO ceiling on the registration fee or charge for the participation in conventions and seminars conducted by DAP, when using government funds. As a backdrop, the DEPARTMENT OF BUDGET AND MANAGEMENT (DBM) issued National Budget Circular No. 442 dated March 29, 1995 and later on amended by National Budget Circular No. 486 dated March 26, 2003 (NBC No. 486) providing for a ceiling of Pl,200.OO, for each participant per day, that could be paid out of government funds as fees for participation by government personnel in seminars and conventions sponsored by non- government organizations or private institutions. In a letter dated April 12, 2004, the President of the DEVELOPMENT ACADEMY OF THE PHILIPPINES (DAP) requested the DBM to exempt DAP from the coverage of NBC No. 486. In the May 13, 2004 letter of Solita S. Recolizado, DIRECTOR, Organization, Position Classification and Compensation Bureau of the DEPARTMENT OF BUDGET AND MANAGEMENT it was declared that DAP is not covered by Pl,200.OO ceiling set by NBC No. 486 because said issuance only covers conventions or seminars sponsored by non-government organizations or private institutions and DAP is a government training institution. It is in this context that you are posing the query on "whether or not such exemption can likewise be implemented in the city government of Iligan as it is clearly stated in the aforesaid letter of DBM. The main purpose is to encourage our employees (sic) attend seminars conducted by DAP... " In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department is of the view that for as long as the seminars and conventions to be attended are to be conducted by DAP, the personnel of the City of Iligan, or any and all government personnel for that matter, would benefit from the subject exemption.

Page 12 In fine, considering that it is DAP as the entire entity entitled to such exemption, any and all government personnel who would participate in such seminars and conventions conducted by DAP are not covered by the ceiling provided for by NBC No. 486. It would be noted that even without the subject letter of the DBM specifically stating the exemption of DAP from the coverage of NBC No. 486, the very provisions of NBC No. 486 is quite clear that it only covers seminars and conventions being sponsored by non-government organizations and private institutions. Considering that DAP is a government training institution, it goes without saying that it is not covered by the Pl,200.00 ceiling set by NBC No. 486. At any rate, the May 13, 2004 letter of DBM only solidified and categorically spelled-out such exemption. We hope that we have addressed your concern on this matter. Respectfully yours, SUS B. OQ EIV Director III LS:19/11
